python: Python is a high-level, interpreted programming language. Key features: dynamic typing, easy syntax, and extensive libraries. Learn basics: https://www.w3schools.com/python/. Example: print('Hello World!')
flask: Flask is a lightweight Python web framework for building web applications quickly. Docs: https://flask.palletsprojects.com/. Example: @app.route('/') defines a route for the homepage.
django: Django is a full-stack Python web framework. Features: ORM, admin interface, templating, security. Docs: https://www.djangoproject.com/
machine learning: Machine Learning (ML) uses data to train models for predictions. Common libraries: scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch. Example: from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
deep learning: Deep Learning uses neural networks with multiple layers. Frameworks: TensorFlow, PyTorch. Example: tf.keras.models.Sequential([...])
data structures: Data structures organize data efficiently. Examples: List, Stack, Queue, Linked List, Tree, Graph, Hash Table. Practice implementing them in Python.
algorithms: Algorithms solve problems efficiently. Examples: Sorting (Bubble, Quick, Merge), Searching (Binary Search), Dynamic Programming (Knapsack, Fibonacci), Graph algorithms (Dijkstra, BFS, DFS).
git: Git is a version control system. Commands: git init, git add ., git commit -m 'message', git push. Docs: https://git-scm.com/
linux: Linux is an open-source OS. Commands: ls, cd, mkdir, rm, chmod, ps, top. Learn to use terminal for file management and process control.
database: Databases store structured data. Types: Relational (MySQL, PostgreSQL), NoSQL (MongoDB). Commands: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, JOIN.
sql: SQL is a language to interact with databases. Example: SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=1; JOIN combines tables. Learn: https://www.w3schools.com/sql/
web development: Web development includes frontend (HTML, CSS, JS) and backend (Flask, Django, Node.js). Learn to create REST APIs and interactive UI.
api: API (Application Programming Interface) allows software to communicate. Example: REST API using Flask: @app.route('/data', methods=['GET'])

css: CSS styles HTML. Properties: color, font-size, display, flex, grid. Example: body { background-color: lightblue; }
javascript: JavaScript makes webpages interactive. Example: document.getElementById('demo').innerHTML = 'Hello';
cloud: Cloud computing provides remote computing resources. Services: AWS, Azure, GCP. Key concepts: EC2, S3, Lambda, VMs, containers.
docker: Docker allows containerization of apps. Commands: docker build, docker run, docker images. Learn: https://www.docker.com/
kubernetes: Kubernetes orchestrates containers. Concepts: pods, services, deployments, clusters. Docs: https://kubernetes.io/
study tips: Study in short focused sessions, take notes, revise daily, practice problems. Use Pomodoro technique and active recall.
algorithms examples: Sorting: BubbleSort, QuickSort, MergeSort. Searching: Linear Search, Binary Search. Dynamic Programming: Knapsack, Fibonacci.
python tips: Use list comprehensions, generators, and built-in functions to write clean Python code. Example: [x**2 for x in range(5)]
flask tips: Use app.run(debug=True) during development. Store secrets in environment variables. Use templates for dynamic HTML pages.
ml tips: Normalize your data, split into train/test, evaluate models using metrics like accuracy, precision, recall. Experiment with hyperparameters.
